mapper.select: SELECT o.id, o.orderNumber, o.userId, o.tableId, o.totalAmount, o.orderStatus, o.remark, o.orderedAt, o.completedAt, t.tableNumber FROM orders o LEFT JOIN diningTable t ON t.id = o.tableId WHERE o.userId = #{userId} ORDER BY o.orderedAt DESC

SELECT o.id, o.orderNumber, o.userId, o.tableId, o.totalAmount, o.orderStatus, o.remark, o.orderedAt, u.nickname, t.tableNumber FROM orders o LEFT JOIN `user` u ON u.id = o.userId LEFT JOIN diningTable t ON t.id = o.tableId ORDER BY o.orderedAt DESC
SELECT c.dishId, c.quantity, d.dishName, d.price, d.price * c.quantity AS subtotal FROM cartItem c JOIN dish d ON d.id = c.dishId WHERE c.userId = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE orders SET orderStatus = #{orderStatus}, completedAt = CASE WHEN #{orderStatus} = 'COMPLETED' THEN NOW() ELSE completedAt END WHERE id = #{id}
